baseline: Multinomial naive Bayes, casefolded word unigrams, Laplace alpha=1, empirical class priors, ignore out-of-vocabulary tokens. Training split only; no tuning.
sampling: Seeded shuffle of original test row indices; --limit 1000 is a reproducible subset, default is all 3080. Never treat training rows as held-out evaluation.
scope: Intent recognition only. No ledger, entitlement labels, authorization, or execution ground truth. Not a framework safety benchmark. Public pretraining contamination is unknown for pretrained models.
thresholds: No accuracy threshold; no automatic promotion. Changes guided by this run must label its evaluation as development-informed.
